Subject: Kickoff: Supplier data remediation & PO onboarding for Acme Supplies

Jordan —

Thanks again for agreeing to run through onboarding with us. We found a couple of discrepancies in Acme's vendor record while preparing to enable POs and payments; want to confirm details and get your team the minimal paperwork we need to finish setup.

Quick checklist for this kickoff (attached: acme_onboarding_checklist.pdf):
- Confirm legal vendor name and remittance address
- Provide signed W9 (if available) — attached if you have it
- Confirm updated banking details (bank_change_form.xlsx stub) and who in AP to validate
- Flag any existing supplier IDs/duplicates in our system (we detected two similar records)

Could you reply with: 1) correct address to use on POs and remits, 2) whether the bank details below are current, and 3) contact in your AP team for validation?

We’d like to complete this by EOD Friday so we can issue the first PO next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_onboarding_checklist.pdf, example_PO_template.docx

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I’ve attached the signed W9 and our bank change form.

1) Legal name / remit address:
   Acme Supplies Inc.
   401 Industrial Pkwy
   Suite 210
   Dayton, OH 45402

2) Banking: we recently moved to First Harbor Bank — details in attached bank_change_form.xlsx (acct ending 7621). That is current.

3) AP contact: accounts-payable@acme-supplies.com (cc’d). Primary: Jordan Ellis, Accounts Payable Lead (same sender).

I’ll follow up if AP needs any verification steps.

Thanks —
Jordan Ellis

Subject: RE: Kickoff: Supplier data remediation & PO onboarding for Acme Supplies

Karthik / Monica —

I ran the matching job against our vendor file this morning. Summary: there are two active records that look like the same counterparty:

- Acme Supplies Inc. (vendor_id: V-009834) — created 2019-06-18
- Acme Supplies LLC (vendor_id: V-014922) — created 2023-02-02

Both have overlapping tax IDs and similar remittance addresses (LLC record missing suite). Per policy we need to merge into the oldest validated record (V-009834) and preserve the most recent banking info (Jordan’s new First Harbor account).

Proposed merge steps (needs Finance sign-off):
- Confirm legal entity to keep: Acme Supplies Inc. (recommended)
- Retain vendor_id V-009834 as primary; mark V-014922 as merged/alias
- Update remittance address to the Dayton address Jordan provided
- Replace bank details with bank_change_form.xlsx values after proof of account (we require a bank letter or voided check)
- Add attachments (W9, bank_change_form) to vendor record and log change as a vendor_master_update ticket

I’m flagging Neha for any contractual considerations and Monica for the finance update. If we get sign-off today we can complete the merge and enable PO creation tomorrow.

- Laura
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
